script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. EMPTY LABORATORY - NIGHT

A LONE SCIENTIST, DR. MAX WEST (30s), works diligently at his lab bench, surrounded by test tubes, beakers, and complex machinery. He wears thick-rimmed glasses, messy hair, and a white lab coat. The room is illuminated only by the soft glow of lab equipment.

DR. WEST
(whispering to himself)
This is it. One more breakthrough, and I'll make history.

Suddenly, the lights flicker and go out, leaving Dr. West in darkness. He looks around, then reaches for his smartphone, illuminating the room with its soft blue light. He begins typing on the phone.

DR. WEST (V.O.)
Log entry 001: The power grid has failed. No weapons, no violence. This is my chance to prove my worth.

EXT. CITY STREETS - DAY

The city is in chaos. Cars lie abandoned in the streets, windows shattered, and wires dangle from power lines. People huddle together in small groups, scared and uncertain. Dr. West, in his lab coat and carrying a backpack, approaches a small group of survivors.

DR. WEST
I have a solution. I can restore power using my invention, but I need your help to gather resources.

INT. REPAIR SHOP - DAY

Dr. West and a group of survivors, led by the STRONG WILLIAMS (40s), work together to repair an old power generator. They exchange stories of loss and hope, bonding over their shared ambition to rebuild their community.

DR. WEST
We can do this. Together, we can bring power back to our city.

EXT. CITY SQUARE - NIGHT

A large crowd gathers in the city square, inspired by Dr. West's vision. He addresses them, his voice filled with determination.

DR. WEST
Together, we can overcome this. We'll rebuild, stronger and better than before.

INT. REPAIR SHOP - DAY (ONE WEEK LATER)

The group works tirelessly to repair the generator. Dr. West is at the forefront, leading the efforts and encouraging the others. Despite the challenges, they remain optimistic.

STRONG
We couldn't have done it without you, Doc. You're a true leader.

INT. EMPTY LABORATORY - NIGHT (ONE MONTH LATER)

Dr. West sits alone in the darkened laboratory, surrounded by the fruits of his labor - the repaired generator and a working prototype of a new, clean energy source. He smiles, knowing that he has made a difference.

DR. WEST (V.O.)
Log entry 010: Power restored, and a new, clean energy source discovered. Ambition has fueled me to make a difference, not just for myself, but for my community.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
